description: PROPOSAL (audit-lane owned). Registry of Tier-A admitted non-axiom inputs accepted as chain-satisfying premises, so that a row depending on one resolves to retained_bounded (cleanly bounded) rather than retained_pending_chain (blocked). DISTINCT from axioms (axiom_premise_nodes.json, never to be derived) and from standard textbook theorems (which must earn retained-grade inline, not via carve-out). Adopting this WIDENS the accepted-premise set beyond pure axioms and will move downstream rows from pending/conditional toward retained_bounded on the next compute_effective_status run -- a deliberate governance decision. 'derivation_targets' are admitted-for-now and each carries a verified retained_no_go portfolio (to be derived via a yet-to-be-found mechanism; on derivation, land a retained theorem and remove the entry, after which compute_effective_status auto-cascades dependents toward retained). 'conventions' are gauge/normalization choices not intended for derivation. Human-readable registry: docs/ADMITTED_INPUT_REGISTRY_TIER_A_NOTE_2026-05-23.md. Safe-by-default: premise_nodes.py treats Tier-A as inert unless this file is present.
